Got it! I can’t click it for you, but here’s the quickest way to launch YouTube right on your own computer:

**If you’re on Windows or macOS:**

1. Press `Win + R` (Windows) or `Command + Space` (macOS) to open the Run/Search box.  
2. Type the URL `https://www.youtube.com` and hit **Enter**.  
   - This will open your default web browser straight to YouTube.

**If you prefer the YouTube desktop app (Windows/macOS):**

1. Open the **Start Menu** (Windows) or **Launchpad** (macOS).  
2. Search for **YouTube** and click the app icon.  
3. Sign in if prompted, and you’re ready to watch.
